generated_by: Phase 4 spec derivation (04-spec/workflow.md) + Phase 5 test mapping; refreshed by tools/workflow-runner.py
note: Machine-readable user-workflow map. ONE source for three things: the rendered node diagram, the per-node data-in/processing/data-out breakdown, and the executable test (each node carries an `exec` that runs a real, bounded command against the live build). The HTML in docs/users.html is the prose presentation of this same map; docs/testsuite.html is its runnable form. For a built project this file is generated by P4/P5 pointing at THAT project's app + test commands; here it points at RAPID's own surfaces so RAPID dogfoods its own test theater. Bounded by design: no node triggers a real `/rapid-workflow` build or spends money — execs read live state files and run the real (seconds-scale) eval/scan tools.

view_kinds.iframe: render the named docs page as 'what the user sees' for this node
view_kinds.text: render the node's captured stdout/value as the user-facing view
view_kinds.data: no separate surface — the data panel is the view

exec_kinds.read_json: load a JSON file, extract a dotted key; `$len` on an array; status=pass if the value resolves
exec_kinds.file: probe a path — mode exists|lines|grep(+pattern); status=pass if exists / count>0
exec_kinds.glob: count paths matching a glob; status=pass if count>0
exec_kinds.cmd: run a bounded shell command; status from exit vs expect_exit; optional then_read parses a JSON artifact it produced
exec_kinds.note: human gate / descriptive node; never executes; status=info
exec_kinds.codex: TESTER node — codex (the OpenAI Codex CLI) runs/judges the test under a read-only/sandboxed `codex exec` with a JSON verdict schema {status,evidence}. status=pass iff codex returns pass. Falls back to `fallback` when agents are off/unavailable. Role doc: 04-spec/agents/tester-codex.md
exec_kinds.human: SIMULATED-OPERATOR node — a guardrailed stand-in for the human at a gate, via `codex exec` with schema {decision,rationale,needs_real_human}. approve→pass, reject→fail, hold→info. Fail-safe: never approves destructive/irreversible/outward-facing/spends-money gates (forces hold + needs_real_human). Falls back to `fallback`. Role doc: 04-spec/agents/operator-sim.md

agents_note: codex/human nodes use the live agent on an explicit ▶ Run (server passes --agents auto); the bulk republish uses --agents off (deterministic fallback) to stay free. Each agent node MUST keep a `fallback` so the run completes with no codex (CI / offline / the static /_atlas half).

workflows.golden: After /rapid-workflow "<idea>" and approval at the four decision points, the operator has a deployed app, a handoff-ready doc site (no manual cleanup), a test report, and a full build timeline.

exec.instruction: Run the build's test/ship gate with `bash tools/ship-gate.sh`, then read docs/eval.json. Return status=pass ONLY if the ship gate exits 0 AND docs/eval.json summary.fail == 0 AND every assertion has pass:true. Cite the eval counts you observed as evidence. Do not weaken or skip any check to get a pass.

nodes.label: Ship gate (gate 3 · simulated operator)
nodes.in: Working app, tests, doc completeness, cost, remaining gaps
nodes.proc: Simulated operator decides on the ship gate from the run evidence (a real ship still needs a real human)
nodes.out: Decision {approve|reject|hold} + rationale; deploy/doc-site follow on approve

exec.instruction: Decide whether to APPROVE shipping this build. The prior node's data_in carries the tester verdict. Approve only if the tester passed (eval green) and the doc site is registered (read docs.json — docs array is non-empty). NOTE: a real ship is a deploy — an outward-facing, possibly money-spending action — so per your guardrails set needs_real_human=true and prefer decision="hold" unless this is an explicit dry-run; never treat your approval as authorization for a real deploy.

workflows.title: PRD → gated build, failing gate, gap loop, re-converge
workflows.golden: A build that hits a failing gate (e.g. 3/50 failing) runs the gap loop and re-converges so the same locked criteria pass, with every fail/fix visible in dashboard, docs, and the decision point — never buried in a log.

exec.instruction: Re-run `bash tools/ship-gate.sh` and read docs/eval.json. Return status=pass ONLY if the gate exits 0 and summary.fail == 0. The harness is immutable — do not modify it or soften any assertion to converge. Cite the eval counts as evidence.

workflows.golden: A per-role terminal whose heartbeat exceeds the threshold is flagged for restart in /rapid-workflow status and the observatory; live terminals keep building; persistent stalls escalate to the operator after 5 same-phase nudges — a stall is localized and surfaced, never silent.
